verdict.rationale: Square ships its own natural-language interface, Square AI (Beta). Sellers can "just ask about their data" instead of hunting through reports, and testimonials describe ad-hoc analysis and charting. Square also documents an official remote MCP server, so AI tools like Claude and Cursor can drive the full API. However, the in-product assistant is evidenced mainly for querying and insights, with "handle routine tasks" left vague, and the feature is still Beta. missing for 10: documented natural-language execution of operational actions (e.g., creating orders, refunds, or catalog edits) within Square AI, GA status, independent hands-on corroboration.
